heading: Mutations between pump cycles
text:
### Mutations between pump cycles [RTCT.12.2]

[RTCT.12.1] bounds the pump. In LIVE the same discipline binds the
mutations that happen between pump calls:

```
T_assert(fact)  = c_wm_insert
                + c_dlheap × log N_ttl          (if the fact has a TTL)
                + c_alpha × A_s × T             (alpha test + insert)
                + c_beta_right × matched × T_j  (for EQ-join betas)
                + c_beta_right × L_β × T_j      (for non-indexed betas)
                + c_agenda × log A              (activation insertion)

T_retract(fact) = c_wm_remove
                + c_dlheap × log N_ttl          (if the fact had a TTL)
                + c_alpha × A_s                 (alpha memory remove)
                + c_beta_ridx × joined × k      (ridx-based retract)
                + c_tms × n_ids                 (if a logical fact)

T_tick_ttl(expired) = c_dlheap × expired × log N_max   (`dynamic_ttl`, heap)
                    + T_retract × expired

T_tick_ttl(expired) = c_fifo × (expired × log n_ttl_schemas + n_ttl_schemas)   (default FIFO queue)
                    + T_retract × expired
```

The full-cycle bound is therefore:

```
T_wcet = T_init_cycle                     (clock cache refresh, budget reset)
       + n_asserts  × T_assert
       + n_retracts × T_retract
       + T_tick_ttl(max_expired_per_tick) (default) or T_tick_ttl(expired_max)
       + T_run(max_fires)                 ([RTCT.12.1])
```

`T_init_cycle` is O(1); `n_asserts` and `n_retracts` are bounded by `N_max`.

Under `linear_scan: false` with default TTL every parameter is a compile-time constant —
`max_expired_per_tick` derives per [LDTL.7.2], `F_max` / `A_max` / `E_rhs` are
`.dsc` topology constants, and `n_ttl_schemas` is fixed at load. The formula
then evaluates to a single fixed number: **`T_wcet` is O(1) in `N_max`** under
that configuration. [LDTL.7.1]–[LDTL.7.4] carry the derivation.
